up: List all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2094269. For each compound, provide its molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2094269';
